programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Chow stars as Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Liang Pao-erh joins the carefree Spinsters’ Club when she discovers her husband is having an affair. Despite the seemingly happy front that her sisters put on, beneath it all, each of them secretly yearns for a man in her life.

programme.title: Flying Swords Of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: Set three years after Dragon Inn, innkeeper Jade has disappeared and a new inn has risen from the ashes - one that's staffed by marauders masquerading as law-abiding citizens, who hope to unearth the fabled lost city buried in the desert.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: A photographer is entangled with a 'woman in red', leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes also died mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: During the Japanese invasion of China, a wealthy martial artist is forced to leave his home when his city is occupied. With little means of providing for themselves, Ip Man and the remaining members of the city must find a way to survive.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Best friends Bodil and Isabel, apparently happily married, sneak off for secret affairs using each other as an alibi. But when Isabel is killed when they were supposed to have been together. Bodil gets caught up in her own web of lies.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Never take your mistress on an annual guys' getaway, especially one devoted to hunting - a violent lesson for three wealthy married men.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: A regime shift in Leka stirs chaos. Police send undercover Zheng Zha into Song Bang’s gang, unaware others are waiting to strike back and settle old scores.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: As a man leaves his wife and daughter, a series of brief conversations, observed gestures, chance encounters and impulsive acts, tell the story of the relationships that flounder and thrive in the wake of this decision.

programme.title: Love On Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: The story revolves around a dutiful yet indifferent fireman, who can march into disaster and risk his lives by saving others, yet would he have the equivalent courage to tackle his personal issues?

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Thongs and Octopus accept a job from their landlord: kidnap a baby. Soon, the baby awakens strong paternal feelings in the two crooks, leading to complications when it comes to handing him over to his possibly crazy gang boss grandfather.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: The story is about a powerful drug-lord in southeast Asia, and the good guys have to save their loved ones under the threat of the Drug business conspiracy.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: An imperial guard and his three traitorous childhood friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later passes and they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: Out Of The Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. Freaked out by the haunting, the security guards invite ghostbuster Leo and his assistant to help.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: Centering on Ip Man's migration to Hong Kong in 1949 as he attempts to propagate his discipline of Wing Chun martial arts.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: Anita Yuan Yung-yi stars as an illegitimate daughter who inadvertently finds a pearl with a genie in it. Michael Wong is the genie who gives her three wishes, leading to a lot of hilarity and even a little heartbreak.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: A Hong Kong taxi driver's life horribly falls apart after accidentally hitting a sorcerer with his cab. He decides to seek the sorcerer's help to turn the curse on his enemies at the expense of his own life.

programme.title: Final Justice
programme.desc: A cop relies on a young car thief to take down four gangsters, who plan to rob a rich merchant for a large amount of money.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: A man received a haunted mail predicting his death. A man mourns the death of his beloved wife. Three brothers clashes over dinner.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist: Chen Zhen
programme.desc: The year is 1917 and Chen Zhen, believed to be dead, returns to Shanghai under a false name. He joins a mob boss for info on the Japanese incl. a long kill list and at night fights the Japanese masked.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: A fantasy-horror set in present-day Moscow where the respective forces that control daytime and nighttime do battle.

programme.title: How To Choose A Royal Bride
programme.desc: The young emperor Kangxi is attempting to select a bride. His mother has arranged for young available women to visit him so that he may choose.

programme.title: The Fate Of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death.

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. Things change, when Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man at Tamotsu's funeral.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: 10 year-old Marbles witness the murder of a young woman.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: A jester is accidentally recruited by a cult leader to spy on a young and inexperienced Chinese emperor. Things don't go according to plan, and he ends up working for multiple opposing sides while trying to survive the madness.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: A young man arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend.

programme.title: Si Bocil Trang Quynh
programme.desc: Kisah Lucu Dan Jenaka Tentang Kehidupan Quynh Dan Orang-Orang Disekitarnya. Sebagai Anak Yang Nakal Tetapi Cerdas Dan Banyak Akal, Quynh Dan Teman-Temannya Akan Membawa Pengalaman Hidup Yang Penuh Warna Di Pedesaan Vietnam Pada Abad Ke-18. Menyoroti Juga Tentang Nilai-Nilai Budaya Rakyat Dan Hubungan Dengan Keluarga, Teman, Guru, Siswa, Dan Lingkungan. Trang Quynh Akan Membawa Tawa Bagi Penonton Dan Mengajarkan Mereka Tentang Keintiman, Persahabatan, Dan Nilai-Nilai Kemanusiaan.

programme.title: Bread Barbershop
programme.desc: Bread, Seorang Tukang Cukur Jenius, Memecahkan Masalah Penampilan Dengan Keterampilan Memotong Rambutnya Yang Briliant. Sekarang Dia Hadir Untuk Memecahkan Masalah Para Bintang Di Bakery Town. Bertentangan Dengan Penampilan Mereka Yang Glamor Dan Bersinar, Para Selebriti Ini Menjalani Hari Yang Sangat Suram. Bread Dan Keluarganya Siap Membantu Para Selebriti Untuk Menemukan Lagi Kebahagiaan Mereka.

programme.title: Metal Cardbot
programme.desc: Dahulu Kala, Terdapat Sebuah Planet Bernama Machina Dimana Metal Cardbots Tinggal. Suatu Ketika, Planet Ini Tiba-Tiba Meledak Dan Memaksa Semua Penghuninya Untuk Hidup Di Bumi. Agar Tidak Menarik Perhatian Makhluk Bumi, Cardbots Menyamar Sebagai Kendaraan Sehari-Hari. Hingga Suatu Hari, Seorang Anak Sekolah Dasar Yang Bernama Jun Secara Tidak Sengaja Menemukan Metal Breath, Dengan Metal Breath Tersebut Dia Bisa Menangkap Dan Menyalakan Cardbots Dengan Kemampuan Yang Berbeda.

programme.title: Grizzy And The Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy & The Lemmings Merupakan Animasi Yang Menceritakan Tentang Seekor Beruang Grizzly Yang Bernama Grizzy Dan Sekawanan Leming Yang Selalu Ingin Bermain Dengan Grizzy Setiap Harinya Sehingga Banyak Cerita Dan Petualangan Yang Menarik Dari Mereka.

programme.title: Blox Buster
programme.desc: Blox Buster Adalah Program Entertainment Yang Menghadirkan Keseruan Bermain Di Dunia Roblox, Platform Game Populer Dengan Jutaan Kreasi Dari Komunitas Global, Penonton Diajak Menjelajahi Berbagai Dunia Virtual Yang Penuh Warna, Menantang, Sekaligus Menyenangkan.
